newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil firm.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was firmer on Tuesday in line with strengthening crude oil futures, traders said.
A Scandinavian player holding February barrels was not actively offering them, but would consider numbers should be around $133 fob NWE. Other dealers assessed this as being too high.
A U.K. player earlier heard seeking early February barrels was heard to have moved his requirement deeper into February.
Russian E-4 cargoes remain in good supply, but all contain high levels of water. Offered premiums to the mean/mean/mean of published quotes were shrinking to under a dollar, traders said.
